summary: The comment from a principal in a school district emphasizes the importance of preserving and strengthening the E-Rate program, as it provides essential infrastructure for modern public education. The principal argues that reducing or eliminating E-Rate would increase operational costs and compete with other essential resources. The comment also highlights the success of E-Rate over the past three decades in providing reliable educational access and supports the claim that E-Rate is not obsolete The comments urge protection of the E-Rate program to ensure continued connectivity for students and schools.

claims.requested_action: Tie E-Rate decisions to educational outcomes
claims.argument: E-Rate has enabled schools to provide reliable educational access
claims.evidence_quote: E-Rate has enabled schools (public and private) and libraries to build and maintain the connectivity necessary for students and patrons to participate fully in modern education

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate would increase operational costs for school districts
claims.evidence_quote: Vermilion Catholic, A Legacy Of Mount Carmel has received $34,299 in committed federal E-Rate support over funding years 2021–2025 — an average of roughly $6,860 a year toward the connections our students depend on.
